title: BigBasket Grocery Scraper Output
description: BigBasket product records with normalized packs, unit prices, anonymous source-context provenance, optional bounded monitoring history, thresholded saved-row alerts, and a machine-readable run summary. Source context does not verify delivery location or fulfillment.

results.title: BigBasket product records
results.description: Saved product rows containing catalog, price, stock, pack normalization, source-context fields and optional tracking/alert fields. Only charged saved rows contribute to monitoring outputs.

monitoringSummary.title: Monitoring run summary (JSON)
monitoringSummary.description: MONITORING-SUMMARY machine-readable run output. Counts and alerts cover saved observations; absent listing products are not inferred to be out of stock.

alerts.title: Saved product alerts (JSON)
alerts.description: ALERTS copies for successfully saved product rows whose configured thresholds triggered. Baseline creation and context/pack resets do not trigger alerts. The Actor does not send outbound notifications.
